positions.description: Skills: Jenkins · Ansible · Docker Products · DevOps

positions.title: Implementation Engineer / Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
• Worked on project team that handles larger and more complex clients to deliver the net new installation for a suite of online banking products.
• Well versed in a variety of areas to install components of software including but not limited to SQL Server, XML, C#, python and JavaScript.
• Managed project cases and troubleshoots issues. With a project from beginning to completion and delivery of product to Financial Institutions end customers.
• Promoted ideas and worked on internal projects for improving internal processes.
• Trained new engineers.
• Communicated with customers and educated them on product functionality.
• Worked with Development and Product teams to find software defects and relay end user's expectations of functionality.

positions.title: Sales Operations Specialist
positions.description:
• Developed reports that gave deeper insight to project backlog, employee productivity, material inventory, and more using data from several different systems.
• Worked on a team to develop a new customer portal that allowed for purchasing material online, viewing the status of projects, and leaving feedback for customer representatives.
• Trained employees on utilizing internal project management application.

positions.title: Rebar Detailer / DBA
positions.description:
• Drafting and Detailing through Microstation and aSa
• Database Development using Microsoft Access and SQL Server
• Programming through Visual Basics for Applications
• 3D Modeling Software Tester with AutoCAD and Bently ProStructures

positions.title: Engineering Tech I
positions.description:
• Worked in Design Division reviewing Plans, Specs & Estimates and contracts for upcoming projects.
• Reviewed Schematic designs for future projects.
• Worked with districts and government agencies such as TDLR and FHWA to complete projects and prepare them for Letting.

positions.title: Intern/Surveyor
positions.description:
• Worked as a rod man and instrument man on survey crews for a variety of different types of work.
• Work experience includes: land development, property line staking, sewer line staking, highway, and topography.
• Experience with Total Stations and GPS equipment.
